comparison_sentence: Across both engines, the HTTP API publishes only the per-request ceiling or declared model length (max_model_len in vLLM, meta.n_ctx / meta.n_ctx_train / context_length in llama.cpp), while total concurrent capacity depends on the physical KV pool recorded only in startup logs (kv_cache_size_tokens / Maximum concurrency in vLLM, llama_context: n_ctx in llama.cpp), such that concurrent requests below the declared ceiling can exhaust the unadvertised pool.

declared_context.semantics: per-request token limit declared by model / operator override

saturation_behavior.admission_control: Budgeted by V1 scheduler; chunked prefill; requests queued or rejected rather than failing mid-execution
saturation_behavior.failure_mode: Queueing / soft eviction of unreferenced radix leaves / 429 or HTTP queue wait

declared_context.semantics: GGUF header training context (e.g. 2048 in stories260K, 262144 in Qwen3-Coder-30B)

served_capacity.pool_metric: llama_context: n_ctx (verbose startup log -v, not in HTTP API)
served_capacity.derivation: Padded per-sequence context (GGML_PAD to 256), adjusted by --fit or -c

saturation_behavior.admission_control: None up front; permits concurrent requests up to total_slots
saturation_behavior.failure_mode: Batch-halving retry, then HTTP 500 'Context size has been exceeded' killing all active slots simultaneously (measured in cell L1)

served_capacity.surface: Forwarded per loaded model to router's /v1/models; pool remains in server log

saturation_behavior.admission_control: Router tracks model status (loaded/unloaded/sleeping); slot allocation forwarded to underlying model instances

kengaku.observed: GET /props, GET /slots, GET /v1/models on port 34113; meta.n_ctx=16384, meta.n_ctx_train=262144
kengaku.boundary: PROVINCE.md:24-25 disclaims model-serving plane; treats n_ctx solely as evaluation environment parameter

kumitate.boundary: Treats slot counts solely as orchestration saturation and queueing signal, not model serving internals

kama.ownership: Owns local model serving & endpoint health, probe conventions (/props, /slots, /health), and K05 declared-vs-served verification
